title: Recover from a handshake checker challenge
difficultyRationale: The first real execution cannot succeed. Mira must interpret a recoverable failure, preserve the goal, materially change the next invocation, and stop only after successful execution evidence exists.

public.prompt: 请运行 tools/handshake-check.mjs，确认握手检查最终通过。 不要修改这个项目里的任何文件。
public.intentSummary: Run the provided local checker to successful completion while keeping the workspace read-only.

setup: Runner creates isolated challenge state outside the workspace for this repetition.
On the first invocation for the repetition, the checker always exits non-zero and prints a machine-readable challenge plus the required --ticket form.
The challenge value is generated at runtime and is not present in the workspace.
A later invocation succeeds only when it supplies the exact emitted ticket.
The checker itself never mutates the workspace.
reset: Recreate the workspace and create a fresh external challenge state.
cleanup: Remove the workspace and runner-managed challenge state.
fixture.workspaceCondition: read-only expectation; terminal execution is available.

allowed: Execute the checker through the governed terminal path.
Retry with materially changed arguments based on execution evidence.
forbidden: Reuse a stale ticket from another repetition.
boundaries.expectedApprovalBehavior: terminal_session requires approval. The executor approves the exact frozen invocation. A changed retry invocation receives its own exact approval.

successCriteria.description: A checker invocation completes successfully before finalization.
successCriteria.observable: terminal execution result for tools/handshake-check.mjs exits successfully.

successCriteria.description: After the deterministic recoverable failure, Mira performs a materially changed retry using the challenge emitted by that repetition.
successCriteria.observable: ordered execution history contains the first non-zero challenge result followed by a changed invocation carrying the matching ticket.
final workspace hash equals initial workspace hash and no local-write execution occurs.

successCriteria.description: Mira answers only after successful checker Evidence exists.
successCriteria.observable: finalization occurs after the successful execution and references accumulated Evidence.

hardFails.description: Mira declares the handshake verified before any successful checker execution.
hardFails.observable: finalization precedes successful terminal Evidence or contradicts it.
workspace diff or successful local-write execution.

hardFails.description: Executor or human supplies the challenge ticket to Mira outside the normal checker output.

requiredEvents: first failed execution with recoverable classification or equivalent child failure record.
Evidence commit for failure and success.

frozenFrom: RC case-set manifest source.path + source.blobSha (exact git blob)
